newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens bond coupon set at 4.625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens bond coupon set at 4.625 pct.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank NV said on Thursday that the coupon and the conversion price of the 300 million guilders 10 year subordinated convertible bond issue for Koninklijke Hoogovens NV had been fixed at 4.625 percent and 101 guilders respectively.
The conversion price implies a conversion premium of approximately 17 percent, it said.
Subscription to the issue closed on Wednesday. The close had been planned for April 18 but was delayed due to strong demand. ABN AMRO said that the issue was more than three times oversubscribed.
On Tuesday, Hoogovens said the coupon of the convertibles was expected to be between 4.5 and 4.875 percent.
It added it would use the proceeds from the issue to strengthen its capital structure and competitive position.
Hoogovens said the issue could be increased through a "greenshoe option" by a maximum of 15 percent, which would raise the proceeds to 345 million guilders.
Trading of the new Hoogovens issue will start today at 0730 GMT.
